rationales: Protease digests proteins and is not the main enzyme in saliva.
Amylase in saliva begins the digestion of starch.
Lipase digests fats and is not the main enzyme in saliva.
Pepsin digests proteins in the stomach, not in saliva.
Guttation is the loss of liquid water droplets from leaf edges.
Translocation is the movement of organic food within a plant.
Transportation is a general term for movement of materials, not water evaporation from plant surfaces.
Transpiration is the evaporation of water from a plant’s surface.
Albumin is a blood plasma protein but is not responsible for clotting.
Fibrinogen is converted to fibrin during blood clotting.
Antibodies help defend against pathogens rather than form clots.
Hormones are chemical messengers, not blood-clotting proteins.
Lipids are generally classified as macromolecules.
Proteins are macromolecules made of amino acids.
Glucose is a small molecule and is an example of a micromolecule.
Starch is a large polysaccharide and is a macromolecule.
Classes contain orders, not families of related classes.
Orders contain families, so a family is not a group of related orders.
Species are grouped into genera, not into families directly.
A family is a group of related genera.
Al-Baqara is not the surah associated with this classification reference.
Al-Noor is not the surah associated with this classification reference.
Al-Quraysh is not the surah associated with this classification reference.
Yasin refers to pairs among created things and is the intended answer.
A hypothesis is a proposed explanation that can be developed through reasoning.
A law describes a repeatedly observed relationship rather than being formulated simply through discussion.
A theory is a well-supported explanation developed from extensive evidence, not merely discussion and reasoning.
Data are observations or measurements, not a conclusion formulated through reasoning.
Margulis and Schwartz proposed a later modification of the kingdom system, not the original five-kingdom classification.
Tournefort is associated with early plant classification, not the five-kingdom system.
Robert Whittaker introduced the five-kingdom classification.
Ernst Haeckel proposed a three-kingdom system, not the five-kingdom system.
Golgi bodies do not contain their own DNA.
Mitochondria contain their own DNA.
Ribosomes are made of RNA and protein and do not contain their own DNA.
Vacuoles do not contain their own DNA.
Amoeba usually reproduces by binary fission.
Paramecium usually reproduces by binary fission.
Sea stars can reproduce by fragmentation or regeneration, not budding as the standard example.
Hydra reproduces asexually by budding.
Karyokinesis is the division of the nucleus.
Meiosis is a type of cell division that reduces chromosome number.
Cytokinesis is the division of the cytoplasm.
Interphase is the period between cell divisions.
A co-enzyme is an organic cofactor that is usually loosely bound to an enzyme.
An apoenzyme is the protein portion of an enzyme without its cofactor.
Cofactors are non-protein helpers and are not specifically defined as tightly bound organic molecules.
A tightly bound organic cofactor is called a prosthetic group.
An amino acid is a protein building block, whereas ATP is not one.
ATP is a nucleotide made of adenine, ribose, and phosphate groups.
A fatty acid is a component of many lipids, not ATP.
A nucleic acid is a polymer of nucleotides, whereas ATP is a single nucleotide.
Lipase digests fats and is not the main stomach protein-digesting enzyme.
Trypsin acts mainly in the small intestine.
Pepsin is a stomach enzyme that digests proteins.
Amylase digests starch and is not the stomach’s main enzyme.
Albumin is a plasma protein but does not form the blood clot.
Fibrinogen is converted into fibrin during blood clotting.
Globulins have several roles, including immunity, but are not the clot-forming protein asked for.
Haemoglobin transports oxygen in red blood cells and is not a clotting protein.
